# typed: strict

module Staff
  class StudentsController < ApplicationController
    extend T::Sig

    include PaginationHelper

    QUERY_LIMIT = T.let(100, Integer)

    before_action :require_staff

    sig { void }
    def initialize
      super
      @student = T.let(nil, T.nilable(User))
      @current_enrollments = T.let(Enrollment.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @current_plans = T.let(Plan.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @activity_records = T.let([], T::Array[PlanActivity])
      @open_activity_records = T.let([], T::Array[PlanActivity])
      @upcoming_activities = T.let([], T::Array[PlanActivity])
      @submission_attempts = T.let(Submission.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @reviewable_submissions = T.let([], T::Array[Submission])
      @daily_reflections = T.let(DailyReflection.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @submissions_by_activity_id = T.let({}, T::Hash[T.nilable(Integer), T::Array[Submission]])
      @reflections_by_activity_id = T.let({}, T::Hash[T.nilable(Integer), T::Array[DailyReflection]])
      @evidence_by_activity_id = T.let({}, T::Hash[T.nilable(Integer), T::Array[EvidenceArtifact]])
      @work_products = T.let(EvidenceArtifact.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @class_scope = T.let(SchoolClass.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @students = T.let(User.none, PaginationHelper::PaginatedScope)
      @counts_by_student = T.let({}, T::Hash[Integer, T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]])
      @round = T.let(nil, T.nilable(Round))
      @current_enrollments_by_student_id = T.let({}, T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Enrollment]])
      @primary_class_for_summary = T.let(nil, T.nilable(SchoolClass))
      @primary_class_enrollment_count = T.let(0, Integer)
      @primary_class_schedule_blocks = T.let(ScheduleBlock.none, ActiveRecord::Relation)
      @waiting_total = T.let(0, Integer)
      @revision_total = T.let(0, Integer)
      @page = T.let(1, Integer)
      @per_page = T.let(PaginationHelper::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE, Integer)
      @pagination = T.let({
        records: User.none,
        page: 1,
        per_page: PaginationHelper::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE,
        total_count: 0,
        total_pages: 1
      }, PaginationHelper::Page)
      @student_count = T.let(0, Integer)
      @rounds = T.let(nil, T.nilable(T::Array[Round]))
      @roster_builder = T.let(nil, T.nilable(Reviews::RosterBuilder))
      @roster_rows = T.let([], T::Array[Reviews::RosterBuilder::Row])
      @roster_waiting_totals = T.let({}, T::Hash[Symbol, Integer])
      @roster_plan_breakdown = T.let({}, T::Hash[Symbol, Integer])
      @roster_evidence_breakdown = T.let({}, T::Hash[Symbol, Integer])
      @roster_final_product_breakdown = T.let({}, T::Hash[Symbol, Integer])
      @participations_by_day = T.let({}, T::Hash[Date, String])
      @activities_by_day = T.let({}, T::Hash[Date, T::Array[PlanActivity]])
      @schedule_origin_path = T.let("", String)
      @schedule_origin_label = T.let("", String)
      @roster_filters = T.let({}, T::Hash[Symbol, String])
    end

    sig { void }
    def show
      scope_hash = SiteScopeResolver.call(
        T.must(current_user),
        active_role: current_active_role,
        active_site: current_active_site
      )
      # WT-02 / S-2 — the stress-empty capture (script/visual_audit_manifest.json)
      # uses a stable username-keyed path so the seed's natural key survives
      # a replant. Accept either a numeric id or a username on this route so
      # the deterministic stress PNG can be produced from a stable identifier.
      raw_id = params[:id].to_s
      student =
        if raw_id.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
          scope_hash[:students].find_by(id: raw_id)
        else
          scope_hash[:students].find_by(username: raw_id)
        end
      @student = student
      return head(:not_found) unless student

      # The schedule is reachable only from Students or Signoff. Do not render
      # a caller-supplied URL into the Back control: an external `origin`
      # would create an open redirect from an authenticated staff surface.
      # A Students origin may retain the canonical roster filters so Back
      # restores the mentor's filtered context without accepting arbitrary
      # paths, duplicate parameters, nested values, or unknown keys.
      schedule_origin = validated_schedule_origin(params[:origin].to_s)
      if schedule_origin == signoff_queue_path
        @schedule_origin_path = signoff_queue_path
        @schedule_origin_label = "Signoff"
      elsif schedule_origin
        @schedule_origin_path = schedule_origin
        @schedule_origin_label = "Students"
      else
        @schedule_origin_path = students_path
        @schedule_origin_label = "Students"
      end

      site = current_active_site
      current_round_ids = Round.where(site_id: site&.id)
                               .current_on(site&.today || Date.current)
                               .select(:id)
      scoped_class_ids = scope_hash[:classes].select(:id)

      @current_enrollments = if site
                               Enrollment.active_on(site.today, site: site)
                                         .where(student: student, school_class_id: scoped_class_ids)
                                         .includes(school_class: :course)
                                         .order(:school_class_id)
      else
                               Enrollment.none
      end
      @current_plans = student.plans
                               .where(round_id: current_round_ids, school_class_id: scoped_class_ids)
                               .includes(:round, :school_class)
                               .order(created_at: :desc, id: :desc)
      activity_scope =
        if site
          PlanActivity
            .joins(plan: :school_class)
            .where(plans: { student_id: student.id, school_class_id: scoped_class_ids })
            .where(school_classes: { site_id: site.id })
        else
          PlanActivity.none
        end
      @activity_records = activity_scope
                          .includes(plan: %i[round school_class])
                          .order(position: :asc, id: :asc)
                          .to_a
      @open_activity_records = @activity_records.reject(&:done?)
      @upcoming_activities = []
      submission_scope = scope_hash[:submissions].where(student_id: student.id)
      @submission_attempts = submission_scope
                             .includes(:evidence_artifacts,
                                       activity: { milestone: { round: { plans: :school_class } } })
                             .order(Arel.sql("COALESCE(submissions.submitted_at, submissions.created_at) DESC"), id: :desc)
      @reviewable_submissions = submission_scope
                                .latest_activity_outcomes
                                .includes(:evidence_artifacts,
                                          activity: { milestone: { round: { plans: :school_class } } })
                                .to_a
                                .sort_by { |submission| [ submission.submitted_at || submission.created_at, submission.id ] }
                                .reverse
      # `state: :submitted` matches the canonical reviewer scope
      # (ReviewsController#show, ReviewWorklist#portfolio_activity_rows). A
      # DailyReflection defaults to :draft - the student's private,
      # un-submitted writing - and this surface rendered `reflection.body`
      # verbatim to staff, so drafts were being read by reviewers.
      @daily_reflections = scope_hash[:daily_reflections]
                           .where(student_id: student.id, state: :submitted)
                           .includes(plan_activity: { plan: %i[round school_class] })
                           .ordered

      @submissions_by_activity_id = @submission_attempts.to_a.group_by(&:activity_id)
      @reflections_by_activity_id = @daily_reflections.to_a.group_by(&:plan_activity_id)

      visible_artifacts = EvidenceArtifact
                          .kept
                          .where(screening_status: :clean)
                          .where(submission_id: submission_scope.select(:id))
      @evidence_by_activity_id = visible_artifacts
                                 .includes(:submission)
                                 .ordered
                                 .to_a
                                 .group_by(&:activity_id)
      @work_products = visible_artifacts
                       .work_products
                       .includes(activity: { milestone: { round: { plans: :school_class } } },
                                 submission: { activity: { milestone: { round: { plans: :school_class } } } })
                       .ordered

      # DA-005 / S-7 — schedule data for the bounded Student
      # schedule surface: participation by day, activities by
      # day, and the current round.
      @round = Round.where(site_id: site&.id)
                    .current_on(site&.today || Date.current)
                    .order(ends_on: :desc, starts_on: :asc)
                    .first || Round.where(site_id: site&.id).order(starts_on: :asc).first
      participation_scope = if @round && site
                              StudentParticipationDay
                                .where(student_id: student.id, round_id: @round.id, site_id: site.id)
                                .order(:participated_on)
      else
                                StudentParticipationDay.none
      end
      participations = participation_scope.to_a
      @participations_by_day = participations.each_with_object({}) do |p, h|
        h[p.participated_on] = p.day_part
      end

      @activities_by_day =
        if @round
          @activity_records.each_with_object({}) do |activity, h|
            next unless activity.plan&.round_id == @round.id
            start_date = @round.starts_on
            next unless start_date

            # The plan calendar is authoritative whenever an activity
            # has a canonical scheduled day. Older unscheduled rows
            # retain the deterministic position fallback so their
            # schedule remains readable until the programme dean
            # supplies dates.
            date = activity.scheduled_on || (start_date + ((activity.position - 1) / 3))
            h[date] ||= []
            h[date] << activity
          end
        else
          {}
        end
    end

    sig { void }
    def index
      scope_hash = SiteScopeResolver.call(
        T.must(current_user),
        active_role: current_active_role,
        active_site: current_active_site
      )
      # AC (analysis feedback, security regression fix): the prior
      # code re-derived the student list by expanding through
      # `Enrollment.where(school_class_id: class_ids)` — which
      # pulled in EVERY student enrolled in any of the viewer's
      # visible classes. For a contractor this was a real leak:
      # the resolver's `:students` key is the assignment set
      # (ContractorSupport rows at the active site), but
      # `:classes` is the set of classes the contractor's
      # assigned students are enrolled in. Expanding via
      # Enrollment.from(:classes) returned every classmate of
      # every assigned student, not just the contractor's
      # assigned set. The fix uses `scope_hash[:students]`
      # directly, which is the canonical narrowed set for the
      # active (role, site) tuple: self for :stu, assigned set
      # for :con, mentor's class roster for :men, site-wide for
      # :dex, org-wide for :sup. For non-contractor roles this
      # is semantically equivalent to the prior expansion (the
      # resolver computes the same set under the hood) so
      # nothing changes for dean / mentor / super-admin.
      @roster_filters = effective_roster_filters
      student_ids = scope_hash[:students].pluck(:id)
      class_ids = scope_hash[:classes].pluck(:id)
      site = current_active_site
      current_scope_enrollments = if site
                                    Enrollment.active_on(site.today, site: site).where(
                                      student_id: student_ids,
                                      school_class_id: class_ids
                                    )
      else
                                    Enrollment.none
      end
      @class_scope = scope_hash[:classes]
                               .where(id: current_scope_enrollments.select(:school_class_id))
                               .order(:name)

      base_students = User.where(role: :stu, id: student_ids)

      # AC-07 / AC-08 — apply ?q= name-LIKE search + ?class_id=
      # class filter ON TOP OF the resolver-derived set so the contractor
      # assignment set cannot leak to classmates. The base scope is
      # `base_students`; the search narrows it via ILIKE on `users.name`,
      # and the class filter intersects the active set with the set of
      # users currently enrolled in the chosen class.
      if params[:q].present?
        query = params[:q].to_s.first(QUERY_LIMIT)
        like = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_like(query)
        base_students = base_students.where("users.name ILIKE ?", "%#{like}%")
      end
      selected_class = nil
      if @roster_filters[:class_id].present?
        selected_class = @class_scope.find_by(id: @roster_filters[:class_id])
        base_students = if selected_class
                          base_students.where(
                            id: current_scope_enrollments
                                .where(school_class_id: selected_class.id)
                                .select(:student_id)
                          )
        else
                          base_students.none
        end
      end

      @students = base_students.includes(:enrollments).order(:name)

      latest_outcomes = scope_hash[:submissions]
                        .where(student_id: student_ids)
                        .latest_activity_outcomes
                        .to_a
      counts = latest_outcomes.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) do |submission, result|
        status = submission.status.to_sym
        result[[ submission.student_id, status ]] += 1
      end
      @counts_by_student = student_ids.each_with_object({}) do |sid, acc|
        acc[sid] = {
          approved: counts[[ sid, :approved ]].to_i,
          draft: counts[[ sid, :draft ]].to_i,
          in_review: counts[[ sid, :in_review ]].to_i,
          submitted: counts[[ sid, :submitted ]].to_i,
          needs_revision: counts[[ sid, :needs_revision ]].to_i
        }
      end

      @round = Round.where(site_id: site&.id).current_on(site&.today || Date.current).order(:ends_on).first

      # AC-07 — expose the class-scope dropdown choices and the
      # per-student current-enrollment lookup so the view can render
      # a DayPartTagComponent chip per row. The lookup is narrowed to
      # the active (role, site) student_ids so a contractor never sees
      # an enrollment for a non-assigned student.
      visible_student_ids = @students.pluck(:id)
      visible_enrollments = current_scope_enrollments.where(student_id: visible_student_ids)
      visible_enrollments = visible_enrollments.where(school_class_id: selected_class.id) if selected_class
      @current_enrollments_by_student_id = visible_enrollments
                                           .includes(school_class: :course)
                                           .to_a
                                           .sort_by do |enrollment|
                                             school_class = T.must(enrollment.school_class)
                                             [ school_class.name.to_s.downcase, school_class.id, enrollment.id ]
                                           end
                                           .group_by(&:student_id)

      @primary_class_for_summary = @class_scope.where(mentor_id: T.must(current_user).id).first || @class_scope.first
      if @primary_class_for_summary
        @primary_class_enrollment_count = current_scope_enrollments
                                          .where(school_class_id: @primary_class_for_summary.id)
                                          .distinct
                                          .count(:student_id)
        @primary_class_schedule_blocks = ScheduleBlock.where(
          school_class_id: @primary_class_for_summary.id
        ).order(:day_part, :id)
      end

      # The AM / PM / MT metric-card row these counts fed has been removed:
      # no decision a mentor makes changes because seven of their students
      # are AM and five are PM. What a mentor needs from this roster is how
      # much is waiting on them, so that is what we compute instead.
      #
      # Computed over the FULL `student_ids` scope, deliberately BEFORE the
      # pagination below. Summing these in the view would iterate the
      # already-paginated `@students` and silently under-report on any
      # roster larger than one page — precisely the scale at which a mentor
      # most needs the number to be true.
      @waiting_total = @counts_by_student.values.sum { |c| c[:submitted].to_i + c[:in_review].to_i }
      @revision_total = @counts_by_student.values.sum { |c| c[:needs_revision].to_i }

      # WT-09 / S-3 / S-4 — canonical roster builder drives the
      # Students home (the three-column roster with the role-aware
      # cells). The builder precomputes the per-student
      # participation chip + plan_approval / evidence /
      # final_product cells + waiting totals + breakdowns. The
      # builder excludes example content (Plan#mentor_example =
      # true) from every count, total, and pass membership per
      # §4.15.
      @roster_builder = Reviews::RosterBuilder.new(
        user: current_user,
        site: site,
        role: (current_active_role || :men).to_sym,
        today: site&.today || Date.current,
        class_id: @roster_filters[:class_id].presence&.to_i || selected_class&.id,
        # The name search is a roster filter too. Apply it at the projection
        # boundary (not merely to the legacy @students relation) so every
        # rendered row, count, empty state, and pass origin describes the
        # same narrowed Students list.
        student_id: @roster_filters[:student_id].presence&.to_i,
        round_id: @roster_filters[:round_id].presence&.to_i,
        review_type: @roster_filters[:review_type].presence,
        status: @roster_filters[:status].presence,
        sort: @roster_filters[:sort].presence
      )
      @roster_rows = @roster_builder.rows
      @roster_waiting_totals = @roster_builder.waiting_totals
      @roster_plan_breakdown = @roster_builder.plan_breakdown
      @roster_evidence_breakdown = @roster_builder.evidence_breakdown
      @roster_final_product_breakdown = @roster_builder.final_product_breakdown

      # Rounds for the round-filter dropdown (round phase + date).
      @rounds = site ? Round.where(site_id: site.id).order(starts_on: :asc).to_a : []

      # WT-15 / AC-06 — paged scope + per-page selector so a 200+ student
      # mentor roster does not render as an unbounded 200+ row table.
      # The metric counts (AM / PM / MT) stay above the filter so the
      # operator sees the full population regardless of the page window.
      # The roster renders the projection rows, not the older @students
      # relation. Paginating that relation left later roster rows visible and
      # made the footer a status-only dead end. Page the canonical projection
      # so the visible rows, count, and links describe the same population.
      requested_per_page = params[:per_page].presence&.to_i || PaginationHelper::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE
      requested_per_page = PaginationHelper::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE if requested_per_page < 1
      @per_page = [ requested_per_page, PaginationHelper::MAX_PER_PAGE ].min
      total_count = @roster_rows.size
      total_pages = total_count.zero? ? 1 : (total_count.to_f / @per_page).ceil
      @page = [ [ params[:page].to_i, 1 ].max, total_pages ].min
      offset = (@page - 1) * @per_page
      @roster_rows = @roster_rows.slice(offset, @per_page) || []
      @pagination = {
        records: User.none,
        page: @page,
        per_page: @per_page,
        total_count: total_count,

  def require_student
    return if current_student
    redirect_to login_redirect_path, alert: "Please sign in as a student."
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_staff
    if current_staff
      # The session-stored active role may already be a staff
      # role (the UserRole chain is intact) BUT the actor's
      # PERSISTED role column may be :stu — a recovery actor
      # whose persisted role was downgraded by the spec 01
      # revocation safety net. We still accept the request
      # because the live UserRole grant authorizes the action;
      # no scope-side redirect fires.
      return true
    end
    # Inactive / revoked staff role — record a permission-denied
    # event so a SUP can audit the rejection (RP-33). The dedupe
    # window keeps a bot probing the same URL from spamming the
    # table. Audit §5.4 closure: route to /denied (role-aware
    # screen) instead of the staff login — the staff login implies
    # "you're not signed in", which is misleading for an
    # authenticated actor with the wrong role.
    record_permission_denied_event("require_staff", reason: "active role not in staff cluster")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Please sign in as a mentor or admin."
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_admin
    return if %i[dex sup].include?(current_active_role)
    record_permission_denied_event("require_admin")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Admin sign-in required."
  end

    @submission = scoped_submission
    activity = @submission.activity
    student = @submission.student
    round = activity&.milestone&.round
    # The resolver-owned evidence activity carries the sole deterministic
    # bridge back to the authoring tree. Never recover a PlanActivity by
    # matching a mutable title or an evidence due date: those values may
    # repeat and must not select a different student's planned day.
    plan_activity = activity&.plan_activity
    raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound unless activity && round && student

    @plan_activity = plan_activity
    @milestone = plan_activity&.plan_milestone
    @round = round
    @student = student
    @daily_reflection = DailyReflection.where(
      student_id: student.id,
      plan_activity_id: plan_activity&.id,
      state: :submitted
    ).ordered.first
    # RS-26 / AC-17 — review-in-context: read-only schedule
    # surface so the mentor judges evidence against the student's
    # actual expectation. NO new before_action; NO change to the
    # require_credit_authority gate (men+dex).
    @schedule_context = ScheduleContext.for(student)
    @schedule_blocks = student.schedule_blocks.ordered
    @next_submission_id = next_submission_id
    @prev_submission_id = prev_submission_id
    @queue_remaining = filtered_index_scope.where.not(id: @submission.id).count

    # DA-004 — build the @round day rail once so the show template can
    # render one row per day without an N+1. Each entry exposes the
    # resolved PlanActivity, its scheduled_on, the latest submission,
    # and a derived row state (Confirmed / Not yet confirmed /
    # Overridden) computed from the latest TimeValueConfirmation row.
    # Rows whose plan_activity belongs to the student round surface
    # the canonical "View details" link to the per-day review; rows
    # without an evidence activity yet link to the readiness surface
    # so the reviewer can drill into the missing day.
    @day_rail_rows = T.let(
      build_day_rail_rows(student: student, round: round, current_submission: @submission),
      T.nilable(T::Array[DayRailRow])
    )

    # §6 / S-3 — when this submission is opened inside an active
    # evidence pass, the "Day n of m waiting" position is rendered
    # in the heading so the reviewer can see how much work remains.
    # When no pass is in scope (a direct link or single-unit view),
    # no position is shown.
    pass_id = params[:pass_id].to_i
    @active_review_pass = T.let(
      pass_id.positive? ? ReviewPass.find_by(id: pass_id) : nil,
      T.nilable(ReviewPass)
    )
    @pass_position = T.let(nil, T.nilable(Integer))
    @pass_total = T.let(nil, T.nilable(Integer))
    @pass_scope_label = T.let(nil, T.nilable(String))
    if @active_review_pass && @active_review_pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s && @active_review_pass.review_type == "evidence" && @active_review_pass.active?
      unit = @active_review_pass.review_pass_units.find_by(submission_id: @submission.id)
      if unit
        @pass_position = T.let(unit.position, T.nilable(Integer))
        @pass_total = T.let(@active_review_pass.total_units, T.nilable(Integer))
        @pass_scope_label = T.let("days in this pass", T.nilable(String))
      end
    end

    # S-4 / DA-003 / §9.6 — concurrent-review notice. When the
    # current open record was claimed by another reviewer
    # mid-review (status flipped to a terminal state within the
    # last 60 seconds AND the reviewing user did not author the
    # last transition), the surface surfaces an in-place notice
    # with the next pending item so the reviewer does not lose
    # their queue position. The shared
    # `shared/_concurrent_review_notice` partial renders nothing
    # when show_notice is false.
    @concurrent_review_show_notice, @concurrent_review_next_path =
      detect_concurrent_review_notice(@submission)

    # Spec 01 RP-45 / TJ-S62 (P0) — append-only
    # operational-inspection access log. Only current_active_role
    # == :sup triggers the write (multi-role SUP switched into
    # :men/:dex falls through the men/dex branch above — RC-65).
    # site_id is stamped with the STUDENT's site for per-site
    # audit attribution (PA-010b). Dedupe: a refresh within the
    # 5-minute window does NOT spam the table — only the FIRST
    # visit in the window writes a row. The recorded reason +
    # category comes from params (set by the operational-
    # inspection banner form) when present; the wrapper fills
    # a sensible default otherwise.
    if current_active_role == :sup
      record_operational_inspection_access(@submission)
    end

    # Spec 01 RP-42 / TJ-S60 — thread the SiteAiSetting
    # version (a STRING like "v1") into instance variables
    # the views / panel partial read so the prompt version
    # stays in sync with the form's hidden ai_setting_version
    # field. The credit action bar partial consumes
    # @site_ai_setting_version. _review_assist_panel.html.erb
    # builds its data-ai-setting-version from the same source.
    student_site = student.site
    @site_ai_setting_version = (student_site &&
                                 SiteAiSetting.for_site(student_site).version).to_s.presence ||
                                "fallback"
  end

  sig { void }
  def approve
    actor = authenticated_user
    submission = ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      locked_submission = lock_credit_submission!(statuses: [ :submitted, :in_review ])
      prior_status = locked_submission.status
      student_site = locked_submission.student&.site
      server_ai_version = student_site ? SiteAiSetting.for_site(student_site).version.to_s.presence : nil
      server_ai_version ||= "fallback"
      locked_submission.update_columns(
        status: Submission.statuses[:approved],
        reviewer_id: actor.id,
        reviewed_at: Time.current,
        updated_at: Time.current
      )
      locked_submission.record_transition!(
        from_status: prior_status,
        to_status: :approved,
        actor: actor,
        metadata: { source: "reviews#approve", ai_setting_version: server_ai_version }
      )
      locked_submission
    end
    flash[:toast] = ActiveSupport::HashWithIndifferentAccess.new(
      level: :success,
      message: "Approved evidence for #{submission.student.display_name}. New state: Approved."
    )
    redirect_after_review(submission)
  end

  sig { void }
  def needs_revision
    submission = credit_action_scope(statuses: [ :submitted, :in_review ]).find(params[:id])
    actor = authenticated_user
    body = params[:feedback_body].to_s.strip
    if body.blank?
      # WT-05 / S-6 — preserve the rejected text + auto-reopen the
      # composer on the show surface so the reviewer does not lose
      # their in-progress feedback (UX-4 / UX-10). The composer
      # partial reads `flash[:review_feedback_draft]` and opens the
      # <details> when present.
      flash[:review_feedback_draft] = params[:feedback_body].to_s
      flash[:open_review_composer] = "1"
      redirect_to review_show_path(submission, active_filter_params),
                  alert: "Add feedback before sending a revision request.",
                  status: :see_other
      return
    end
    ApplicationRecord.transaction do
      submission = lock_credit_submission!(statuses: [ :submitted, :in_review ])
      prior_status = submission.status
      student_site = submission.student&.site
      server_ai_version = student_site ? SiteAiSetting.for_site(student_site).version.to_s.presence : nil
      server_ai_version ||= "fallback"
      submission.update_columns(
        status: Submission.statuses[:needs_revision],
        reviewer_id: actor.id,
        reviewed_at: Time.current,
        updated_at: Time.current
      )
      submission.record_transition!(
        from_status: prior_status,
        to_status: :needs_revision,
        actor: actor,
        metadata: { source: "reviews#needs_revision", ai_setting_version: server_ai_version }
      )
      Comment.create!(
        author: actor,
        commentable: submission,
        visibility: :student_visible,
        body: body
      )
      Notification.create!(
        recipient: T.must(submission.student),
        actor: actor,
        notifiable: submission,
        kind: "evidence_returned",
        title: "Evidence Not Approved — Return with Notes",
        body: body
      )
    end
    flash[:toast] = ActiveSupport::HashWithIndifferentAccess.new(
      level: :warning,
      message: "Not Approved — Return with Notes for #{submission.student.display_name}. New state: Not Approved."
    )
    redirect_after_review(submission)
  end
  # HOW-TO-FIX (analysis feedback) — block time-value edits after
  # the round has been signed off. Once a RoundCreditSignoff row
  # exists for the (student, round), the only path back is the
  # RC-17 reopen flow; a silent confirm_time_value write would
  # mutate the audit trail without a Reopen row.
  sig { void }
  def confirm_time_value

# typed: strict

class ContractorCourseAssignment < ApplicationRecord
  extend T::Sig

  belongs_to :contractor_user, class_name: "User"
  belongs_to :site
  belongs_to :course

  validates :contractor_user_id, uniqueness: { scope: :course_id }
  validate :contractor_user_at_site
  validate :course_at_site
  validate :contractor_user_is_contractor

  private

  sig { void }
  def contractor_user_at_site
    contractor = contractor_user
    assignment_site = site
    return if contractor.nil? || assignment_site.nil?
    return if contractor.site_id == assignment_site.id
    return if contractor.user_roles.exists?(site_id: assignment_site.id)

    errors.add(:contractor_user, "must be at the same site as the assignment (or hold a UserRole at that site)")
    errors.add(:site, "must match contractor_user's site or one of their UserRole-anchored sites")
  end

  sig { void }
  def course_at_site
    assigned_course = course
    assignment_site = site
    return if assigned_course.nil? || assignment_site.nil? || assigned_course.site_id == assignment_site.id

    errors.add(:course, "must be at the same site as the assignment")
    errors.add(:site, "must match course's site")
  end

  sig { void }
  def contractor_user_is_contractor
    contractor = contractor_user
    assignment_site = site
    return if contractor.nil? || assignment_site.nil?
    return if contractor.user_roles.exists?(site: assignment_site, role: :con)
    return if contractor.con? && contractor.site_id == assignment_site.id

    errors.add(:contractor_user, "must hold the contractor role at the assignment site")
  end
end

#   - evidence_cell          (Symbol + label + waiting flag + days count)
#   - final_product_cell     (Symbol + label + waiting flag)
#
# All cell states use the canonical §7 vocabulary: Waiting,
# Resubmitted, Recommended, Approved, Not Approved, Not yet due,
# Not yet submitted, Up to date, No plan yet, Nothing to review,
# Awaiting a second reviewer, pending.
#
# Example content (Plan#mentor_example = true) is excluded from
# every count, total, and pass membership (§4.15).
class Reviews::RosterBuilder
  extend T::Sig

  Cell = T.type_alias do
    {
      state: Symbol,
      label: String,
      waiting: T::Boolean,
      detail: T.nilable(String),
      secondary_label: T.nilable(String)
    }
  end

  Row = T.type_alias do

      student: User,
      participation_chip: String,
      plan_approval: Cell,
      evidence: Cell,
      final_product: Cell,
      has_any_work: T::Boolean,
      oldest_waiting_at: T.nilable(ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone)
    }
  end

      round_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      review_type: T.nilable(String),
      status: T.nilable(String),
      sort: T.nilable(String),
      query: T.nilable(String)
    ).void
  end
  def initialize(user:, site:, role:, today: nil, class_id: nil, student_id: nil, round_id: nil, review_type: nil, status: nil, sort: nil, query: nil)
    @user = user
    @site = site
    @role = role
    @today = T.let(today || site&.today || Date.current, Date)
    @class_id = class_id
    @student_id = student_id
    @round_id = round_id

    @status = status
    @sort = sort
    @query = T.let(query.to_s.strip.presence, T.nilable(String))

  def total_count
